title: Token Nexus — Cost Mapper & Pricing Patterns for Console
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Overview: Design a token-level cost analytics view (Token Nexus / Cost Mapper) inside Redwood Console that surfaces per-token line items, attribution to routes/models/users, and exportable artifacts. This ticket covers exploratory pricing UI patterns (tiered vs microprice vs hybrid), CSV/JSON export schema, prototype interactions, and handoff artifacts for ENG and PM.

Goals:
- Make cost attribution transparent at token granularity without overwhelming users.
- Provide a compact inspector for tracebacks: mapping each generated token back to route, model variant, quantization profile and routing tier.
- Offer export-ready schemas for downstream billing and customer reporting.
- Surface pricing patterns that enable both unit-price and bundled-tier views.

Constraints / Non-goals:
- Not building billing engine; this is a UI/contract spec and prototype.
- No realtime per-token streaming in first iteration (backend supports batched samples via ENG-4812).
- Sensitive payloads must be excluded; only metadata and derived token counts are shown.

Design rationale: We avoid raw token dumps. Instead, the Token Nexus emphasizes summarization + drilldown. The top row is a compact cost fingerprint (total tokens, model cost, caching savings, routing uplift). Secondary pane lists line-item "billing fingerprints" (route/model/quantization/prefix cache hit) which can expand into per-token buckets with sampling. Pricing patterns include: microprice (per-token unit), tiered slab (thresholds), and hybrid (per-token inside tiered bands with credits). UI should let finance teams toggle between USD and internal unit-cost, and switch time windows and attribution granularity (by route / by user / by model).
comments: 2026-02-11 — Aisha Kumar: Initial exploration sketch uploaded to Figma. Focused on a three-tier layout: fingerprint bar, line-item table, and token inspector modal. Raised question about how to show cached vs evicted KV cost impact.

2026-02-17 — Liam O'Connell: Incorporated PM feedback — added "pricing mode" toggle (Unit / Tiered / Hybrid) and sample price preview. Created prototype flows for toggling between invoice-ready CSV and developer ledger view.

2026-02-24 — Product (Nora Hayes): Reviewed. PM note: must align export schema with Finance team CSV requirements (columns: invoice_date, customer_id, route_id, model, quantization_profile, token_count, unit_price_usd, total_usd, credit_applied). Listed ENG dependency ENG-4812 for backend contract. Marked customer_impact as high.

2026-03-02 — Eng (Marco Lin): Design review — backend can return per-request attribution buckets but not per-token text due to privacy. Suggested we sample tokens for inspector UI rather than full dumps. Noted performance constraints: large result sets require pagination and server-side aggregation.

2026-03-05 — Aisha Kumar: Prototype updated; added sampling modal with provenance badges (route/model/variant/cache-hit). Added micro-interaction: hover on a fingerprint shows cost delta vs baseline (e.g., quantized -20%). Added copyable export schema snippet for ENG.

2026-03-09 — Design review panel: Feedback from Finance and Legal — ensure exported CSV obfuscates any PII and includes a hash for request_id for auditability. Legal requested a short note in UX about "Data exported contains derived metrics only; request content is not exported".

2026-03-10 — Liam O'Connell: Updated acceptance criteria and uploaded final handoff package to Drive. Ready for ENG PR and API contract sign-off. Scheduled follow-up for post-implementation usability test in Cycle 2026-W12.
acceptance_criteria: Top-level cost fingerprint showing total tokens, estimated USD, caching savings, and routing uplift is visible and matches sample backend payload.
Line-item table supports grouping by route, model, or user and shows unit price, token count, credits, and total. Sorting and column picklist implemented in prototype.

Export action produces CSV and JSON conforming to provided schema; CSV includes invoice_date, customer_id, route_id, model, quantization_profile, token_count, unit_price_usd, total_usd, credit_applied, request_hash.
Pricing mode toggle correctly switches preview calculations between Unit / Tiered / Hybrid and reflects changes in the fingerprint and estimated totals.
Token inspector modal returns sampled tokens with provenance badges, and the UI shows clear labelling that token text is sampled and may be pseudonymized for privacy.
Design handoff includes Figma frames, color tokens, spacing, and micro-interaction notes; ENG-4812 contract fields documented in Confluence.
Legal/Finance checklist completed: export privacy note, hashed request id, and CSV column mapping reviewed and approved.
